messages:
sam: Heads-up — we've got a release scheduled for tonight's change window 22:00-23:00 PST. Version: v2024.04.2. Pin list attached in PR (https://git.redwood/release/4321). Please sanity-check rollback/runbook links and flag any blockers.

deploybot: Scheduled rollout created. Canary plan: 10% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% over 10m. Rollback hook: `redwoodctl releases unpin --version v2024.04.2` (manual) or reply with `abort` in this thread within the window to trigger immediate pause.

maria: Reviewed release notes, looks straightforward. @naveen can you confirm whether any infra/schema migrations are needed? If yes we need the DB toggle ready. :eyes:

naveen: No DB schema change. It's a cache header tweak and a feature flag flip. Feature flag: `cache-new-logic`. To revert: `curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/flags/cache-new-logic -d 'false' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN"`. I will be standing by.

elaine: SRE checklist: watch inference-runtime 5xx rate and tail latency. Runbook snippet: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/rollback-playbook-v3 — auto-rollback criteria = error_rate > 2% sustained for 3m or p95 latency > 800ms for 2m. Manual rollback quick steps:
- `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime`
- `redwoodctl releases pin --version v2024.04.1`
- clear cache: `redis-cli -h redis-main FLUSHDB` (use only after coord)
I'll have alert dashboards open and will trigger the runbook if thresholds hit.

jeff: Also confirm dedicated GPU model pinning for heavy workloads. If the new release pulls model v1.8 we risk perf variance. @sam?

sam: Confirmed: heavy-gpu pool pinned to `model-v1.7-quant` for this window. Release PR includes pinned model hashes. I'll be oncall for the window and reachable on my cell.

maria: I'll monitor tracing and synthetic checks. I'll post if baseline latency climbs above 150ms P50 or any steady error spike.

deploybot: Canary started at 22:00 PST. 10% traffic routed to v2024.04.2. Canary dashboard: https://dash.redwood/canary/rel-4321. Reply `abort` here to pause and roll back the canary.

naveen: abort

deploybot: Abort command received from naveen. Pausing rollout and initiating rollback per runbook. Reverting traffic to v2024.04.1 and applying pin. Notifying oncall and posting rollback notes to: https://incidents.redwood/rollbacks/4321.

sam: Thanks — appreciate the quick action. Will open a post-rollout sync after we confirm metrics are stable. Closing thread for now.
